desc: **Task 0 — Ideation**: identify key insights (zero digit ⇒ beautiful; nonzero products are 7-smooth; leading-zero handling).

**Task 1 — Implement solution**: `count(N)` digit DP with memoized `(rem, started, s, p)` free states, leading-zero `started` flag, terminal check `started and p % s == 0`, `p == 0` short-circuit, wrapper `count(r) - count(l-1)`.

**Task 2 — Testing & performance validation**: examples (10–20 → 2; 1–15 → 10), edge cases (`l=1` ⇒ `count(0)=0`, `r=999999999`), correctness argument vs brute force, and worst-case timing (one-time memo build, module-level cache reuse).
